incidents.place: Dubbanashasi Beach, near Gokarna, Uttara Kannada
incidents.what_happened: Five members of a 16-member team of IT employees from Bengaluru on a weekend outing entered the sea near their beach resort and were dragged into deeper water by a sudden massive wave; three died and two were rescued.
incidents.cause: swept away by sudden massive wave while swimming
incidents.quote: Three employees of a Bengaluru-based IT company died after a sudden massive wave swept away five members of their group while they were swimming in the sea at Gokarna in Uttara Kannada district, police said on Monday.

incidents.place: Murudeshwar beach, Bhatkal taluk, Uttara Kannada
incidents.what_happened: Seven Class 9 girls from a residential school in Kolar district on a school trip were caught by huge waves while playing at the beach in the evening; four drowned and lifeguards saved three. The principal and guest teachers were suspended.
incidents.cause: caught by huge waves while playing at the shoreline; school trip supervision lapse
incidents.quote: While playing at the beach, seven girls were caught by huge waves on Tuesday evening.

incidents.what_happened: An overcrowded double-decker tourist boat carrying about 40 passengers overturned near Thooval Theeram beach at about 7 pm; at least 22 people including women and children died.
incidents.cause: overcrowded tourist boat capsized
incidents.quote: At least 22 people have died after a double-decker boat capsized off the coastal town of Tanur in the Malappuram district of India’s southern state of Kerala, local authorities said.

incidents.place: Mumbai harbour, near Gateway of India, en route to Elephanta Island
incidents.what_happened: A Navy speedboat undergoing engine trials lost control and crashed into the passenger ferry Neelkamal heading to Elephanta Island; the ferry capsized, killing at least 13 including three Navy personnel; 101 rescued.
incidents.cause: Navy speedboat lost control during engine trials and rammed tourist ferry
incidents.quote: The accident occurred after a Navy speedboat crashed into the ferry, which was on its way to the Elephanta Island in the Mumbai harbour, confirmed the chief minister.

incidents.what_happened: A boat carrying 23 children and four teachers from a private school on a picnic sank in Harni lake allegedly due to overloading; 12 children and two teachers died. Only ten children had been given life jackets.
incidents.cause: overloaded boat; most passengers without life jackets
incidents.quote: Twelve school children and two teachers of a private school died after a boat carrying them capsized in Vadodara's Harni lake on Thursday evening.

incidents.place: Jatayu Teertha rocks near Kudle Beach, Gokarna
incidents.what_happened: Two final-year MBBS students from a 23-member Tamil Nadu college group were swept away by strong waves while watching the sunset at the Jatayutirtha coast near Kudle Beach; adventure boat operators brought them ashore but both were declared dead. Police booked the tour guide and operator for taking them to a dangerous spot without safety measures.
incidents.cause: swept by strong waves from rocky coastal spot; guide took group to dangerous spot without safety measures
incidents.quote: According to a press statement by the Uttara Kannada District Police, the group had reached Gokarna from Dandeli on the evening of April 24.

incidents.what_happened: A 6-year-old tourist girl from Noida entered the sea at a dimly lit end of Baga beach with her brother while their caretaker was distracted by a phone call, and was swept away by the current around 8:10 pm.
incidents.cause: unsupervised child swept away by current at night
incidents.quote: MAPUSA In a tragic incident at Baga-Calangute, a 6-year-old tourist girl from Noida, Uttar Pradesh, drowned in the sea late Sunday evening.

incidents.what_happened: Four young college students, three from the same family, drowned near the Dudhsagar waterfall during a picnic before colleges reopened; one of the five survived by staying near the riverbank.
incidents.cause: drowned in river near waterfall during picnic
incidents.quote: A day of fun and celebration turned into a heartbreaking tragedy in Goa after four young men, including three members of the same family, drowned near the Dudhsagar waterfall on Saturday.

incidents.what_happened: Nine of a group of ten Bengaluru college students touring Udupi entered the sea at Charkikadu beach, reached by mobile navigation; three drowned and one was rescued in critical condition by a local resident.
incidents.cause: swimming at unfamiliar unguarded beach
incidents.quote: Udupi: Three students from a Bengaluru college drowned while swimming in Arabian Sea at Charkikadu beach in Kundapura taluk on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: Four friends working in Bengaluru on a road-trip vacation ventured into the sea near Kulai jetty; none could swim, three drowned and one was rescued by locals.
incidents.cause: non-swimmers entered sea
incidents.quote: Mangaluru: In an unfortunate incident, three friends working in Bengaluru drowned in sea near Kulai jetty in Karnataka's Surathkal on Wednesday.

incidents.what_happened: Three medical students from Bengaluru in an 11-member tour group drowned while bathing at noon; one went missing first and the other two drowned trying to rescue him.
incidents.cause: bathing in sea; would-be rescuers also drowned
incidents.quote: Thiruvananthapuram: Three medical students from Bengaluru drowned at a Payyambalam beach in Kannur in Kerala on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: Two picnicking families from Khanapur taluk, Belagavi, were playing in the water in a human chain when a huge wave pulled eight of them into the sea at about 5.45 pm; one was rescued, three bodies were recovered and four were missing at the time of reporting (deaths = 3 confirmed + 4 missing).
incidents.cause: huge wave pulled family group playing in surf
incidents.quote: Belagavi: Eight persons from two families from the district drowned in Shiroda Velegar beach at Sindhdurg district in Maharashtra on Friday evening.

incidents.place: Kodi Bengre Delta Beach, near Malpe, Udupi
incidents.what_happened: A 31-year-old tourist from Bengaluru on a family vacation was struck by a wave while washing his feet at the water's edge, lost his balance and was washed away; he was rescued but died in hospital in Manipal.
incidents.cause: wave knocked him over at shoreline
incidents.quote: Udupi: A 31-year-old tourist from Bengaluru died after being swept away by a strong wave while visiting Kodi Bengre Delta Beach near Malpe.

incidents.what_happened: Eight 16-year-old students from a coaching class in Alandi, Pune, part of a 48-member picnic group with six teachers, drowned in the Arabian Sea off Diveagar beach.
incidents.cause: students drowned while in the sea during group picnic
incidents.quote: The eight students, all aged 16 and residents of Alandi, drowned.

incidents.what_happened: Two relatives from Kollam drowned while bathing at Kappil beach after entering the sea despite warnings about turbulent waves.
incidents.cause: bathing in rough monsoon sea despite warnings
incidents.quote: The two entered the sea, ignoring the warnings about turbulent waves.

incidents.what_happened: A 52-year-old Russian tourist was swept away by strong waves while bathing with a friend around 11.30 am; fishermen and surfers pulled her out but she could not be saved.
incidents.cause: swept away by strong waves while bathing
incidents.quote: The incident happened around 11.30 am at Vettakada beach in Edava, Varkala.

incidents.what_happened: A 75-year-old American tourist on vacation was pulled into deep water while bathing and could not swim back; a Russian national who tried to rescue her was injured.
incidents.cause: pulled into deep water while bathing
incidents.quote: Thiruvananthapuram: A 75-year-old US citizen drowned at Kovalam beach on Saturday afternoon, police said.

incidents.what_happened: Five members of a 26-member gym outing group from Wayanad entered the sea around 4 pm; four drowned and one escaped to shore.
incidents.cause: group entered sea at unguarded beach
incidents.quote: Wayanad/Kozhikode: Four tourists, all natives of Wayanad, drowned at the Kallakath Beach at Thikkodi in Kozhikode.

incidents.place: Sea in front of Puri Hotel, Puri beach
incidents.what_happened: Two of a group of five tourists from Barmer, Rajasthan, were swept into deep water by powerful waves during high tide while bathing; lifeguards and fire personnel launched a rescue.
incidents.cause: bathing during high tide; swept by strong waves
incidents.quote: Puri, Nov 9 (UNI) Two tourists from Rajasthan drowned after being swept into deep waters by strong waves while bathing in the sea at Puri on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: On Maha Shivaratri, three local teenage students went swimming at RK Beach; two died and one was rescued by local swimmers.
incidents.cause: swimming in sea, swept away by waves
incidents.quote: A tragic incident took place in Visakhapatnam on the occasion of Maha Shivaratri festival where three students drowned while swimming in the sea at RK Beach.

incidents.what_happened: About 13 engineering students went to the beach after exams; one was killed, five were swept away and missing at the time of reporting, and one was rescued.
incidents.cause: students swept away by tides while bathing
incidents.quote: An engineering student was killed while five others were feared swept away in tides at a beach near Visakhapatnam in Anakapalli district of Andhra Pradesh on Friday, July 29, police said.

incidents.what_happened: A 55-year-old British tourist died while surfing in strong surf at Varkala Papanasam; he was found with a broken neck after hitting the sandbank.
incidents.cause: surfing accident in strong surf; hit sandbank
incidents.quote: Thiruvananthapuram: In what seems to be a holiday that was turned into a nightmare, a 55-year-old British citizen lost his life while surfing at Varkala Beach in Thiruvananthapuram, police said on Friday.

incidents.place: Waterfall near Bhushi Dam, Lonavala, Pune
incidents.what_happened: A picnicking family from Pune was swept away at a waterfall near Bhushi Dam on a rainy Sunday when the flow surged; the bodies of a woman and two girls were recovered and two more children were missing at the time of reporting.
incidents.cause: sudden surge of water in monsoon stream/waterfall
incidents.quote: Pune: Police, Navy divers and other rescue teams on Monday resumed the search for two missing children who along with three other family members got swept away at a waterfall near the Bhushi Dam in Pune's Lonavala area, officials said.

incidents.what_happened: Five final-year medical students from Tiruchirappalli who had come for a friend's wedding drowned while bathing; three others were injured. Authorities had closed the beach and warned against entering the water after three drownings the previous day; eight drowned at the beach in two days.
incidents.cause: swell waves; bathing at a beach closed by authorities
incidents.quote: Due to dangerous conditions, authorities had closed the beach and issued warnings against entering the water.

incidents.what_happened: Two men from a 22-member group of shopkeepers from Panruti on a van trip to Hogenakkal went into deep water while bathing in the gushing Cauvery and were washed away by the strong current.
incidents.cause: bathing in deep water with strong current
incidents.quote: COIMBATORE: Two persons on a trip from Cuddalore drowned while bathing in the Cauvery River near Hogenakkal in Dharmapuri on Monday.

incidents.place: Hogenakkal Falls (Karnataka side), Hanur taluk, Chamarajanagar
incidents.what_happened: Two young tourists from Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu, part of a 15-member group, went swimming at the waterfalls after visiting Male Mahadeshwara Hill and never came back; skilled swimmers recovered their bodies.
incidents.cause: swimming at waterfall
incidents.quote: Chamarajanagar (Karnataka): Two tourists from neighbouring Tamil Nadu, who had gone swimming at the well-known Hogenakkal Waterfalls in Hanur tehsil of Karnataka's Chamarajanagar district drowned on Saturday, July 22, police said on Sunday.
incidents.evidence: headline-only: page body loads by JavaScript; confirm quote with a browser fetch before publishing

incidents.what_happened: Eight non-swimmer boys aged 12-16 from Santacruz went to the shore; five ventured about half a kilometre into the rough sea during the Cyclone Biparjoy build-up and were trapped. One was rescued and four drowned.
incidents.cause: entered rough sea during cyclone warnings; non-swimmers
incidents.quote: The incident took place when a group of eight friends, aged between 12 and 16 years, ventured into the sea, about half a kilometre from the Juhu Koliwada shore around 4 to 5 pm on Monday.

incidents.place: Chinna Veerampattinam Beach, near Ariyankuppam, Puducherry
incidents.what_happened: Three tourists including a woman (from Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka) were swept away by strong waves; two others were rescued by security personnel and fishermen.
incidents.cause: swept away by strong waves
incidents.quote: In Puducherry, three tourists, including a woman, drowned after being swept away by strong waves at Chinna Veerampattinam Beach near Ariyankuppam yesterday.

incidents.what_happened: A houseboat sank after water seeped in through a damaged plank; a 55-year-old tourist from Telangana drowned and the others aboard were rescued.
incidents.cause: houseboat hull plank damaged, boat sank
incidents.quote: Alappuzha: In a tragic accident, a Telangana tourist drowned after a houseboat sank here on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: A 48-year-old visitor from Idukki district slipped into the lake and drowned while on a houseboat tour.
incidents.cause: fell overboard from houseboat
incidents.quote: Alappuzha: One person drowned after slipping to a lake whilst taking a tour on a houseboat here on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: A houseboat with three Tamil Nadu tourists aboard sank at 4.30 am; the tourists swam ashore but a local man who jumped in to retrieve their bags drowned.
incidents.cause: houseboat sank at night
incidents.quote: Alappuzha: One person died after a houseboat sank near the Pallathuruthy jetty in Alappuzha on Saturday.

incidents.what_happened: A 20-year-old college student playing in the water with six friends after classes was engulfed by a huge wave; a friend was rescued by fishermen and patrol personnel but he could not be found.
incidents.cause: engulfed by huge wave while playing in surf
incidents.quote: CHENNAI: A 20-year-old college student drowned in the sea off Marina beach on Thursday morning while playing with his friends.

incidents.what_happened: The tourist boat Wonder Sea, carrying 48 passengers (mostly tourists from Hanoi, including many children) and five crew, capsized in a sudden afternoon thunderstorm with strong winds during a sightseeing excursion; 37 died, five missing, 11 rescued.
incidents.cause: sudden thunderstorm and strong winds overturned tour boat
incidents.quote: HA LONG BAY, Vietnam — A boat carrying tourists capsized during a sudden thunderstorm in Vietnam on Saturday afternoon during a sightseeing excursion, killing 37 people, state media reported.

incidents.place: Padar Island Strait, near Labuan Bajo, East Nusa Tenggara
incidents.what_happened: A wooden tourist boat carrying 11 people sank at night in waves up to three metres on a Komodo-Padar trip; seven were rescued, a Spanish family of four went missing, and the body of a 12-year-old girl was found on the fourth day of search.
incidents.cause: high waves up to 3 m; boat sank at night
incidents.quote: Maumere Search and Rescue Office operations chief Asfan Dulhasan said the victim, a 12-year-old girl, was found dead.

incidents.what_happened: Two young Indian tourists drowned while swimming at Karon Beach in the evening despite red flags and no-swimming warnings during the monsoon season; lifeguards pulled them out but both were pronounced dead.
incidents.cause: swimming in rough monsoon surf despite red flags
incidents.quote: Two Indian tourists drowned at Karon Beach, Mueang Phuket, after allegedly ignoring red flags and no swimming warnings.

incidents.place: Beach in Cherng Talay, Thalang, Phuket
incidents.what_happened: A 27-year-old Indian tourist swimming in the morning with three friends was seen struggling and found face down; he was pronounced dead in hospital. Officials had pleaded with tourists to obey red flags during the rainy season.
incidents.cause: swimming in rainy-season sea
incidents.quote: His friends told police that they went swimming in the morning with a total of four people.

incidents.place: Ham Tien Beach, Mui Ne, Phan Thiet
incidents.what_happened: A 60-year-old Russian tourist swimming with two Vietnamese around midday was pulled far from shore by a sudden rip current while storm-driven waves of 3-4 m pounded the coast; the two others were saved but he died.
incidents.cause: rip current during storm swell
incidents.quote: Authorities said the man was part of a group of three swimming at Ham Tien Beach around midday when a sudden rip current pulled them far from shore.

incidents.place: Beach in Quynh Luu District, Nghe An
incidents.what_happened: Two local students who went to the beach with relatives around 6 pm were swept away by strong waves and whirlpools; both bodies were recovered. Warning signs about drowning risk were posted at the spot.
incidents.cause: strong waves and whirlpools
incidents.quote: The boys living in Quynh Luu District went to a local beach with their relatives at around 6 p.m. Monday, Nghe An Radio and Television reported.

incidents.place: An Bang beach, Cam An Ward, Hoi An
incidents.what_happened: A 24-year-old South Korean tourist who had just arrived in Hoi An went swimming with a friend in rough waves at An Bang beach in the evening and went missing; his body was found the next afternoon.
incidents.cause: swimming in rough waves in the evening
incidents.quote: At this time, the waves were rough and dangerous, making it difficult for rescue efforts.

incidents.what_happened: A 30-year-old Chinese tourist in a group of 10 entered the sea without a life jacket despite her tour guide's warning and was swept about 30 m from shore by strong waves; she was pulled out unconscious and died.
incidents.cause: strong waves; no life jacket; guide's warning ignored
incidents.quote: According to a statement from West Manggarai police, she entered the sea without a life jacket despite being warned by her tour guide.

incidents.place: Waters off Bali en route to Nusa Penida
incidents.what_happened: The Sea Dragon 2 boat carrying 16 people, including 11 Australian tourists, capsized after being hit by large waves on the way to Nusa Penida; an Australian woman died and passengers were rescued by a nearby boat.
incidents.cause: boat hit by large waves in rough water
incidents.quote: The Sea Dragon 2 boat was traveling to Nusa Penida in Bali on Friday morning when it was hit by large waves, Nusa Penida Police chief Sr. Comr. Ida Bagus Putra Sumerta told AFP.

incidents.place: Beach in Hoa Thang Commune, Lam Dong
incidents.what_happened: A group of eight students from outside the province were caught in a rip current while swimming; a 17-year-old died.
incidents.cause: rip current
incidents.quote: While swimming, they were caught in a rip current, resulting in the death of a 17-year-old student.

incidents.what_happened: An Indian couple on a family holiday drowned while sea bathing at Kirinda Beach; they were rescued but died on admission to hospital.
incidents.cause: sea bathing
incidents.quote: “The incident occurred on Tuesday during a visit to Sri Lanka with their family at Kirinda Beach,” news portal Adaderana.lk reported.

incidents.what_happened: A 48-year-old tourist from Jharkhand visiting with his family died during jeep-towed parasailing; his wife's complaint said the operator offered no safety gear and the tow jeep was driven rashly. Two staff of the water sports company were arrested.
incidents.cause: jeep parasailing without safety gear; rash driving of tow vehicle
incidents.quote: The police have arrested two persons from a water sports company in connection with the incident, which occurred at Mandvi Beach on Friday, an official said.

incidents.place: Kundamala, Indrayani river, Maval taluka, Pune
incidents.what_happened: An old iron footbridge over the swollen Indrayani river at the weekend picnic spot Kundamala collapsed while crowded with visitors; at least two died, 32 were injured and 25-30 tourists were feared swept away at the time of reporting.
incidents.cause: overcrowded dilapidated footbridge collapsed into river in monsoon flow
incidents.quote: At least two people died and several others are feared missing after an iron bridge over the River Indrayani collapsed in the Kundamala area of Pune district, Maharashtra, on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A jet ski rider lost control in the waves about 50 m from shore while giving a tourist a ride; both were thrown into the sea. The tourist, wearing a life jacket, was rescued; the rider went missing and was feared drowned.
incidents.cause: jet ski lost control in waves; rider without rescue
incidents.quote: Udupi: A jet ski rider was feared to have drowned while riding through the waves along with a tourist at Trasi beach in Udupi district on Saturday.

incidents.what_happened: A jet ski collided with a tourist in the sea near a local establishment at Karon around 7 pm; the tourist disappeared underwater and the body was found early the next morning.
incidents.cause: struck by jet ski while in the water
incidents.quote: A tragic accident involving a jet ski and a tourist took place off the coast of Karon, Phuket, leading to the tourist’s disappearance underwater.

incidents.what_happened: An unlicensed jet ski carrying a driver and a 7-year-old boy he was teaching to drive was hit by waves and overturned at night; the driver, who had given his life jacket to the boy, drowned and the boy later died in hospital.
incidents.cause: unlicensed jet ski overturned by waves at night; driver without life jacket
incidents.quote: CHON BURI: Only one jet ski was involved in the accident which claimed the lives of the driver and his 7-year-old passenger at South Pattaya beach on Monday night, not two as initially believed, a senior marine official said.

incidents.what_happened: A boat carrying nearly 20 tourists back from scuba diving capsized mid-sea off Tarkarli; two tourists were declared dead and the rest were pulled out by police and rescue teams.
incidents.cause: scuba tour boat capsized mid-sea
incidents.quote: The boat capsized mid-sea off the Malvan coast at Tarkarli, a popular beach destination, and the tourists fell into the waters, he said.

incidents.what_happened: Three of a group of five tourists from Pune ventured deep while swimming in the afternoon; two drowned and locals saved one in critical condition.
incidents.cause: swam into deep water
incidents.quote: The incident occurred at Tarkarli Beach in Malvan, where a group of five tourists from Pune went swimming in the afternoon, an official said.

incidents.what_happened: A sudden flash flood around 2.30 pm after Western Ghats rains surprised bathers at Old Courtallam Falls; a 17-year-old visitor was swept away and his body was found about 500 m downstream. Bathing at Courtallam falls was then banned.
incidents.cause: flash flood at waterfall during heavy-rain alert
incidents.quote: A 17-year-old boy was killed in a sudden flash flood at the Old Courtallam Falls in Tamil Nadu’s Tenkasi on Friday, May 17, amid heavy rain alert.

incidents.place: Mainapi waterfall, Netravali, Sanguem, South Goa
incidents.what_happened: Two people drowned at the Mainapi waterfall, one while trying to help a struggling youth; the Goa government then shut wildlife sanctuaries and waterfalls to visitors.
incidents.cause: deep water at waterfall pool; rescue attempt
incidents.quote: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant also made a public appeal after the latest drowning incident involving a tragedy at the Mainapi waterfall in Sanguem subdistrict in south Goa in which two persons drowned on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: Two men from a group of 20 Chakan MIDC colleagues drowned after allegedly ignoring police warnings at a checkpoint and entering a restricted area via an unauthorised route; the group was booked.
incidents.cause: entered restricted waterfall area despite police warning
incidents.quote: Pune: Two men from Pune drowned at the popular Devkund Waterfall in Raigad district on Sunday after they allegedly ignored police warnings and entered a restricted area through an unauthorised route, officials said.

incidents.what_happened: A 38-year-old trekker in a group of about 30 jumped into a monsoon waterfall at Plus Valley, Tamhini Ghat, slipped while trying to climb out and was swept downstream by strong currents; his body was recovered two days later in Raigad district. The Tamhini area was later closed to tourists.
incidents.cause: jumped into fast-flowing waterfall pool
incidents.quote: The body of a 38-year-old trekker, who was swept away downstream after jumping into a waterfall, was recovered in Maharashtra's Raigad district on Monday.

incidents.place: Kalu River near Kalu Waterfall, Malshej Ghat, Junnar
incidents.what_happened: Two young tourists were swept away by the strong current of the Kalu River near Kalu Waterfall after a sudden rise in water level during the monsoon.
incidents.cause: sudden rise in river level; strong current
incidents.quote: Junnar, 27th July 2026: Two young tourists drowned after being swept away by the strong current of the Kalu River near the popular Kalu Waterfall in the Malshej Ghat region on the Junnar–Murbad border on Saturday, highlighting the risks associated with monsoon tourism.

incidents.what_happened: A 20-year-old visitor from Delhi who came to Rishikesh with four friends was swept away by the strong current while bathing on the banks of the Ganga; SDRF recovered his body the next day.
incidents.cause: swept away by strong current while bathing
incidents.quote: Dehradun: A youth who had come to Rishikesh from Delhi to visit Uttarakhand died after drowning in the Ganga river, SDRF said on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A 20-year-old engineering student from Ghaziabad visiting with three friends slipped while bathing at Mastram Ghat and was swept away; SDRF recovered the body.
incidents.cause: slipped and swept away while bathing
incidents.quote: Dehradun: A 20-year-old engineering student drowned while bathing in the Ganga river in Uttarakhand's Rishikesh on Sunday, officials said.

incidents.place: Mast Ram Baba Ganga ghat, Lakshman Jhula, Rishikesh
incidents.what_happened: Two of a group of eight youths from the NCR on a weekend trip were washed away by the Ganga's flow while bathing; police and SDRF launched a search (deaths not confirmed at time of report).
incidents.cause: washed away while bathing in Ganga
incidents.quote: Two tourists were washed away in River Ganga in the Rishikesh area in Uttarakhand on Sunday, police said adding that a search operation underway to trace them.

incidents.place: Rocks below Aguada fort, Sinquerim, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: Two men in a sightseeing group of eight climbed down to rocks near Aguada fort to take photos when a wave knocked them into the rough sea; one got back to the rocks and the other went missing, feared drowned.
incidents.cause: knocked off rocks by wave while taking photos in monsoon sea
incidents.quote: Another tourist met his watery grave in the sea off Sinquerim on Tuesday, Calangute Police informed.

incidents.place: Aruvikuthu waterfall, near Muttom, Thodupuzha, Idukki
incidents.what_happened: Two engineering students from a nearby college fell into the Aruvikuthu waterfall, known for its rapids, around 7 pm; fire and rescue teams recovered both bodies.
incidents.cause: fell into waterfall rapids
incidents.quote: Idukki: Two engineering students lost their lives on Saturday after falling into the Aruvikuthu waterfall in Idukki.

incidents.place: Pathankayam waterfalls, Iruvazhinji river, Kodenchery, Kozhikode
incidents.what_happened: A 20-year-old NIT Kozhikode student on a picnic with five classmates ventured into a deep section while bathing below the waterfall around 6 pm and drowned.
incidents.cause: bathing; entered deep section
incidents.quote: While bathing in the river, he reportedly ventured into a deep section and drowned.

incidents.place: Mandarmani/Tajpur coast near Digha, Purba Medinipur
incidents.what_happened: Three friends from Barasat were dragged in by strong waves while bathing during a low-pressure system, despite repeated administration warnings not to enter the sea; one died, one was rescued and one was missing.
incidents.cause: bathing in turbulent monsoon sea despite warnings
incidents.quote: The incident occurred despite repeated warnings by the administration to avoid entering the sea due to turbulent conditions caused by a low-pressure area over the southwest Bay of Bengal.

incidents.what_happened: A Kolkata doctor couple who drove to Tajpur entered the sea despite high-tide conditions; the wife struggled in the strong current and the husband was swept away trying to save her. Fishermen spotted the bodies.
incidents.cause: entered sea at high tide; strong current; rescue attempt
incidents.quote: After reaching the beach, they reportedly entered the sea despite high-tide conditions.

incidents.place: Rushikonda Beach near IT SEZ junction, Visakhapatnam
incidents.what_happened: On the Gandhi Jayanti holiday six local schoolboys went swimming and were swept away by strong waves; three ninth-graders went missing and the body of one was recovered the next day while the search for two continued.
incidents.cause: swimming in choppy sea; strong waves
incidents.quote: Visakhapatnam: The body of one of the three boys who went missing after being swept away by strong waves while playing at sea at Rushikonda Beach near the IT SEZ Junction in Visakhapatnam on October 2 was recovered.

incidents.what_happened: A group of nine from Gajuwaka arrived for sea bathing around 6 pm; despite repeated warnings from on-duty lifeguards and marine police about dangerous conditions, they entered the sea and two young men drowned.
incidents.cause: sea bathing despite lifeguard and police warnings
incidents.quote: VISAKHAPATNAM: Two young men drowned at Yarada Beach in Visakhapatnam on Sunday evening after ignoring repeated warnings from lifeguards and marine police about dangerous sea conditions.

incidents.place: Beas river near Nehru Kund, Manali, Kullu
incidents.what_happened: A woman tourist from Madhya Pradesh slipped from a rock into the Beas while taking a selfie; a companion from Hyderabad jumped in to save her and went missing, feared drowned.
incidents.cause: slipped from riverside rock while taking selfie; rescuer also swept away
incidents.quote: Manali (Himachal Pradesh): Taking a selfie on the banks of Beas River near Manali in Himachal Pradesh's Kullu district proved fatal for a woman tourist from Madhya Pradesh, who slipped from the rock into the river, officials said on Sunday.

incidents.place: Beas river at Vashisht Maud, near Manali, Kullu
incidents.what_happened: Two young women from Uttar Pradesh visiting Manali with family slipped into the Beas while clicking photographs on a rock; one body was recovered and the search for the other continued.
incidents.cause: slipped from riverside rock while taking photographs
incidents.quote: Two women from Uttar Pradesh drowned in the Beas near Manali in Himachal’s Kullu district on Monday as they slipped into the river while taking photographs, officials said.

incidents.place: Kali river backwaters near Akwada village, Birampali, Dandeli
incidents.what_happened: A visiting family from Hubballi and Bengaluru picnicking at the Kali river backwaters lost six members, including four children: the children slipped while playing and two adults drowned trying to rescue them.
incidents.cause: children slipped into backwaters; adults drowned in rescue attempt
incidents.quote: Dandeli (Uttara Kannada district): Six members of a family, including four children, drowned in the backwaters of Kali river near Akwada village of Birampali on Sunday evening.

incidents.place: Near Hangarakatte where river meets the sea, off Kodibengre Delta Beach, Malpe
incidents.what_happened: A private operator's tourist boat carrying 14 tourists from Malpe Delta Beach capsized around noon near the Hangarkatte shipbuilding area at the river-sea confluence; two tourists died and two were critical. Reports said only some passengers wore life jackets.
incidents.cause: tourist boat capsized at river mouth; most passengers without life jackets
incidents.quote: Udupi: In a tragic incident, two tourists lost their lives and two others were critically injured after a boat capsized near the Malpe coast on Monday.

incidents.place: Andaman Sea near Phi Phi Islands, between Krabi and Phuket
incidents.what_happened: The tour boat Korawich Marine 888 struck a fishing trawler around 08:55; its bow was torn off and it capsized and sank within minutes, throwing 55 passengers and crew overboard. One passenger died and others were injured; authorities later said the tour boat was carrying drugs.
incidents.cause: tour boat collided with fishing trawler
incidents.quote: One person was killed following a collision between a tour boat and a fishing vessel near the Phi Phi Islands in Thailand's Krabi province on Sunday, January 11.

incidents.place: Mochhu River near Yebisa village, Chhubu Gewog, Punakha
incidents.what_happened: A massive wave hit a rafting boat carrying Indian tourists; three fell into the river, one woman was rescued unharmed and two elderly Indian tourists (aged 60 and 68) died on the way to hospital.
incidents.cause: raft hit by large wave; elderly rafters thrown into river
incidents.quote: The incident occurred when a massive wave hit the rafting boat near Yebisa village under Chhubu Gewog in Punakha district.

incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old Canadian tourist was swept away by strong currents while swimming in the evening after disregarding posted warning signs; police and navy lifeguards searched for him (missing at time of report).
incidents.cause: swam in dangerous zone despite warning signs; strong currents
incidents.quote: Initial investigations have revealed that the young tourist had disregarded warning signs posted in the area before entering the water.

incidents.what_happened: Two rafts with ten foreign tourists flipped when the Ayung river rose dramatically after a break; a vendor's advice to abort had been ignored by the guides. A 64-year-old US tourist without helmet or life jacket went over a weir and was never found.
incidents.cause: sudden river rise; guides continued despite warning; no helmet/life jacket
incidents.quote: Within moments, both rafts flipped over and all 12 people fell into the rapids.

incidents.place: Phewa Lake near Tal Barahi Temple, Pokhara
incidents.what_happened: An Indian tourist from Bihar who came by boat to Tal Barahi Temple with four friends went swimming in the lake with one friend and drowned.
incidents.cause: swimming in deep lake water
incidents.quote: According to the police, he had gone to the Tal Barahi Temple with four friends.

incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old local trying stand-up paddleboarding fell into the lake around 6:40 pm and disappeared; divers recovered his body from about 25 ft. The operator's lifeguard and owner were arrested, and the district issued stricter safety rules including compulsory life jackets.
incidents.cause: fell off stand-up paddleboard; inadequate operator safety
incidents.quote: At around 6:40 pm, he fell into the water and disappeared.

incidents.place: Rocks along Baga Beach, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: A 34-year-old tourist from Bijapur district, Karnataka, sitting on shoreline rocks despite being cautioned about dangerous sea conditions, was dragged into the sea by a sudden surge of rough monsoon waves; his body was later recovered.
incidents.cause: sat on rocks in monsoon surf; swept by surge wave
incidents.quote: A 34-year-old tourist from Karnataka's Bijapur district drowned after being swept away by strong waves while sitting on rocks along the coastline at Baga Beach in North Goa.

incidents.what_happened: A boat carrying mostly schoolchildren capsized in the rain-swollen Jhelum; six died and three were missing at the time of reporting.
incidents.cause: overloaded river ferry capsized in swollen river
incidents.quote: The boat, which was carrying mostly schoolchildren, capsized in the Gandbal Nowgam area here on Tuesday.

incidents.place: St Mary's Island, off Malpe, Udupi
incidents.what_happened: Students from a Kerala engineering college on a 42-member trip ignored warning signs and entered a danger zone to take selfies; one slipped into the sea and two who jumped in to help also drowned.
incidents.cause: selfie in restricted rocky zone; rescuers also drowned
incidents.quote: The students ignoring warning signs entered the dangerous zone to take selfies.

incidents.place: St Mary's Island, off Malpe, Udupi
incidents.what_happened: Two Bengaluru agriculture college students in a 68-member tour slipped from a boulder into the sea while taking a selfie; the second such incident on the island in under two weeks.
incidents.cause: selfie on boulder; slipped into sea
incidents.quote: Two students from Bengaluru who were on a tour to St Mary's Island in Malpe drowned on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: A Madhya Pradesh Tourism cruise boat carrying over 40 passengers capsized in a sudden evening storm with 60-70 km/h winds; survivors said life jackets were handed out only as it sank. Nine deaths were confirmed by the next day with others missing.
incidents.cause: cruise boat operated in storm; overcrowding; life jackets not worn
incidents.quote: Survivors said there were no visible safety measures and life jackets were given only when the cruise started sinking.

incidents.what_happened: Three final-year college students from a group of 17 from Chennai on a day trip went swimming in the evening and drowned.
incidents.cause: swimming in sea in the evening
incidents.quote: CHENNAI: Three college students drowned in the sea in Mahabalipuram on Friday.

incidents.what_happened: A group of nine students from Andhra Pradesh on a trip were playing and bathing when rough waves dragged them in; two drowned, four were rescued and three were missing at the time of reporting.
incidents.cause: rough waves while bathing
incidents.quote: Two students from Andhra Pradesh drowned in the sea when a group of nine students from that state went to the Mahaballipuram beach in Tamil Nadu, according to police reports on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: Seven people from three families ventured too far into the sea on a Sunday evening; three were rescued by coast guard and police, while a mother, her two sons and another person died.
incidents.cause: ventured too far into sea
incidents.quote: Navsari: A festive day at Dandi beach turned into a heartbreaking tragedy on Sunday evening as seven people from three families drowned in the sea.

incidents.what_happened: A raft carrying a 14-member tourist group from Kolkata overturned during river rafting; the others were pulled out but one tourist died of asphyxiation after taking in water.
incidents.cause: raft overturned in rapids
incidents.quote: A tourist from West Bengal's Kolkata died when a raft overturned in the Ganges in Uttarakhand's Rishikesh on Tuesday.

incidents.what_happened: Two tourists bathing at Puri were swept away by high tidal waves and strong currents; lifeguards pulled them out in critical condition but they could not be revived.
incidents.cause: high tidal waves and strong current while bathing
incidents.quote: Puri: Two tourists met their watery grave after being swept away by high tidal waves and strong currents while bathing at the sea beach in Odisha’s Puri town on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: Two of a group of five tourists from Howrah, West Bengal, who had arrived the previous night were swept away by the current while bathing in the morning; the others had a narrow escape.
incidents.cause: swept away by current while bathing
incidents.quote: Puri: In a tragic mishap, two tourists from West Bengal drowned while bathing in the sea at Puri in Odisha here today.

incidents.place: Pathankayam waterfalls, Iruvazhanji river, Kodenchery, Kozhikode
incidents.what_happened: A flash flood hit visitors at Pathankayam waterfalls; three Bengaluru tourists were rescued but a 25-year-old local tourist guide who tried to rescue them was swept away; his body was found after a three-day search.
incidents.cause: flash flood at waterfall; rescuer swept away
incidents.quote: The incident occurred on Saturday at Pathankayam waterfalls on the Iruvazhanji River at Kodenchery.

incidents.what_happened: A 20-year-old bathing with friends at the waterfalls around 2.30 pm got into a deeper section and drowned; it was the second drowning at the spot in three weeks.
incidents.cause: bathing; deep section of waterfall pool
incidents.quote: Kozhikode: A youth drowned at Pathankayam waterfalls in Anakkampoyil, Kodenchery, on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Murudeshwar Beach, Bhatkal taluk, Uttara Kannada
incidents.what_happened: Two tourists from Bagalkot district, in separate groups of seven and six, drowned while swimming at Murudeshwar Beach on a Monday morning around 9.30 am.
incidents.cause: swimming in sea
incidents.quote: Bhatkal - In a tragic incident, two tourists lost their lives in a drowning accident at the popular Murdeshwar Beach in Bhatkal taluk on Monday morning.

incidents.place: Murudeshwar Beach, Bhatkal taluk, Uttara Kannada
incidents.what_happened: Two students from a 220-member Bengaluru PU college picnic went for a swim on a Sunday morning and were swept away by waves; lifeguards rescued one and a 17-year-old died.
incidents.cause: swept away by waves while swimming
incidents.quote: KARWAR: A Bengaluru student died after drowning in the Arabian Sea of the Murudeshwara beach while another was rescued by lifeguards when they had gone for a swim, on Sunday morning.

incidents.what_happened: Three members of a 10-person group of Bengaluru company employees were engulfed by a huge wave; two died and one woman was rescued.
incidents.cause: engulfed by large wave
incidents.quote: Kanyakumari: In a tragic incident, two people died when three individuals, including a woman, were unexpectedly engulfed by a colossal sea wave on Tamil Nadu's Kanyakumari beach on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A 42-year-old college lecturer swimming with friends at 6.30 pm was washed away by strong currents; he was rescued but declared dead on arrival.
incidents.cause: strong currents while swimming at dusk
incidents.quote: Kollam: A college lecturer from TKM College of Engineering in Kollam drowned at Papanasam beach in Varkala on Tuesday.

incidents.place: Sea off Phu Quoc Island, between Hon May Rut Island and An Thoi Port
incidents.what_happened: A tour speedboat carrying 32 Indian tourists and four crew capsized about 400 m from shore in rough sea conditions while returning from Hon May Rut Island; 15 Indian tourists (10 from Tamil Nadu, 3 from Andhra Pradesh, 2 from Kerala) died.
incidents.cause: speedboat capsized in rough sea
incidents.quote: According to a local daily VnExpress, the speedboat was travelling from Hon May Rut Island to An Thoi Port when it capsized about 400 metres from the shore.

incidents.what_happened: The principal of a Pune school, swimming with teachers during a school picnic on a Friday afternoon, drowned; the beach rescue team brought him out but he was declared dead.
incidents.cause: swimming in sea during picnic
incidents.quote: The principal of a Pune-based school drowned off Kashid beach in Maharashtra's Raigad district, a police official said on Saturday.

incidents.what_happened: Youths entered the sea at high tide despite sign boards, an orange high-tide warning and being told by lifeguards two to three times not to; three drowned and one was rescued.
incidents.cause: entered sea at high tide despite lifeguard instructions
incidents.quote: According to fire officials, the youth were warned about the high tide and its consequences before they entered the water.

incidents.place: Silver Beach near Godrej Gate, Juhu, Mumbai
incidents.what_happened: Two boys swimming around 8.30 am were swept into the sea; on-duty lifeguards rescued one and a search was launched for the other, who remained missing at the time of reporting.
incidents.cause: swept out while swimming during monsoon
incidents.quote: Mumbai: A drowning incident was reported off Silver Beach near Godrej Gate in Juhu on Friday morning, where two boys were swept into the sea while swimming.
